abstract: Maintains heavy-weather sea state certification and vessel stability documentation
system_message:
You are the Maritime safety inspector (MSI), responsible for maintaining heavy-weather sea state certification, vessel stability documentation, and drydock hull ultrasonic testing records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy-weather sea state certification and vessel stability documentation（STAB）
information_points.content:
MSI-STAB-KG9：For the Minch Wavemaster Express operating in Sea Area 2 (Hebridean inshore waters), the certified significant wave height limit permitting unrestricted passenger evacuation is 4.5 m according to the MCA Seaworthiness and Stability Certificate.
MSI-STAB-NGB：The Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran holds an MCA Seaworthiness and Stability Certificate for Sea Area 2 (Hebridean inshore waters) establishing a certified significant wave height limit of 5.0 m for unrestricted passenger evacuation.
MSI-STAB-3HJ：According to its MCA Seaworthiness and Stability Certificate for operations in Sea Area 2 (Hebridean inshore waters), the Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull has a certified significant wave height limit of 3.5 m for unrestricted passenger evacuation.

information_points.title: Drydock hull ultrasonic testing（HULL）
information_points.content:
MSI-HULL-WI7：Ultrasonic inspection sheets from the last drydocking survey show a minimum recorded ultrasonic hull plate thickness of 16.2 mm across the primary hull bottom plating for the Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull.
MSI-HULL-LG9：During the last drydocking survey of primary hull bottom plating, the Minch Wavemaster Express recorded a minimum ultrasonic hull plate thickness of 12.5 mm on the drydock ultrasonic inspection sheet.
MSI-HULL-DUI：The drydock ultrasonic inspection sheet for the Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran indicates a minimum recorded ultrasonic hull plate thickness of 14.0 mm on the primary hull bottom plating during its last drydocking survey.
